overview_description.description:
Watad digital is a leading system integrator and solution provider for the following sectors:
1- Cybersecurity for IT and OT/ICS: Design, supply, installation, configuration, testing and commissioning
2- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions
3- Industrial Automation: HMI/SCADA, PLC, RTU, DCS, PSA
4- Smart Cities solutions: Smart lighting, smart parking, access control systems, CCTV, IoT
5- IT infrastructure: Servers, Switches, Routers, Surveillance systems, ...
6- Aerospace: Space academies, space curriculum.
